create_dialog_accept: create a playwright dialog handler that accepts a dialog with a prompt text
create_dialog_dismiss: create a playwright dialog handler that dismisses a dialog without accepting
test_dialog_accept_prompt: test the Dialog.accept method with prompt text for alert and prompt dialogs
test_dialog_dismiss: test the Dialog.dismiss method to close a dialog without submitting
review_dialog_properties: review the Dialog class type, message, default_value, and page properties
